description: Globs of the historical records a retired product root (D-113) or a retired vendor (D-318) may still be named in: they describe the past and are not rewritten (units, programs, ADRs, audits, the frozen project, the roadmap and process records, the decision register), plus the definitions of the roots and of the vendor terms themselves and their generated types; and .gitleaks.toml, whose allowlist must name paths of past commits because the secret scan judges the whole history.
